logp.method_description: The partition coefficient between 1-octanol and water (P) was measured as following. Ruthenium complexes were dissolved in 1-octanol (2 mL, 10 uM), then water (2 mL) was added to the solution and the mixture was stirred sufficiently for partitioning. The concentrations of the compound in the 1-octanol phase before and after partitioning were measured by absorbance of the sample. The P value was calculated according to P = {(Cbefore - Cafter)}/Cafter.
